                                          BUILDINGS BULLETIN 2016-009
                                                          Operational


           Rescinds:          Memorandum: Form Waiver Letters For Local Law 58/87 (August 31, 1988)

               Issuer:        Thomas Fariello, RA
                              First Deputy Commissioner

     Issuance Date:           April 6, 2016

            Purpose:          This bulletin rescinds one Memorandum pertaining to Local Law 58 of 1987 that is no longer
                              applicable under the 2014 NYC Building Code

       Related Code           BC 1101.3.5
           Sections:          LL 58/87

            Subjects:         Local Law 58 of 87, waiver recommendation request; form waiver letter; Accessibility Waiver
                              Letters; Mayor’s Office for People with Disabilities; Accessibility; Waiver of Accessibility
                              Requirements


The Department of Buildings is currently in the process of reviewing published Buildings Bulletins (BBs), Policy and
Procedure Notices (Technical, Operational, Legal, Administrative, OTCR), and various memoranda, directives, and
letters to see if changes are necessary to reflect current Department practice and incorporate new laws and
regulations.

Effective immediately, the following is rescinded:
          Memorandum: Form Waiver Letters For Local Law 58/87 (August 31, 1988)

Rescinded documents will not be applicable to any projects after the issuance date of this Bulletin. They will appear
on the Department website with the watermark “RESCINDED.”

Because the process is ongoing, documents not specifically listed in this Bulletin may still be addressed in future
bulletins.

Watermarked Letters and Memorandum may be accessed through the online version of this Bulletin at:
http://www.nyc.gov/html/dob/html/codes_and_reference_materials/buildings_bulletin.shtml
